subject: Archer portal onboarding — evidence hashchain & presign key rotation
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@clearforge.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: operations@clearforge.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 14:04:00 -0700
Subject: Archer portal onboarding - presign + evidence mapping

Hi David,

Thanks for taking this. We're kicking off our Archer profile setup for Clearforge and want to confirm a couple of things before we upload evidence into the portal:

- Our security team will provide an evidence index (attached) with links to artifacts stored in an S3 bucket. We prefer to supply SHA256 hashes for each artifact rather than re-uploading binaries. Will Redwood accept a hash manifest for ingestion?
- We rotate the S3 presign KMS key monthly. For onboarding, is there a preferred window for a presign/key rollover so temporary URLs remain valid during your ingest?
- Any format constraints for CAIQ/SIG fields we should be aware of when mapping?

Attaching clearforge-evidence-index.csv which has filenames + s3 paths. We also have a SOC 2 attestation question — is there a single security contact we should reference for audit liveness checks?

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Security Operations | Clearforge

Attachment: clearforge-evidence-index.csv (csv stub, 28 rows)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@clearforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Archer portal onboarding - presign + evidence mapping

Alyssa — thanks for the index. Yes, SHA256 hashes are fine for our intake pipeline; we record the hashes on ingest and store the manifest as part of the Archer profile evidence. A few implementation notes: 

- Presign TTL: please use a 72-hour presign TTL for uploads to our ingestion bucket for the onboarding wave. We'll run an ingestion job daily during the window to pick up newly signed objects.
- Key rotation window: schedule the KMS rotation at least 96 hours after the final presign is issued to avoid invalidating URLs mid-ingest. For safety, we recommend performing rotation on a Tuesday morning (US/PST) so we can monitor.
- Metadata: add the CAIQ mapping column in the CSV (column header caiaq_field). If you prefer, we can share a mapping template.

I'm attaching our short playbook (redwood-presign-playbook.pdf) with the presign pattern we expect and the internal tag we add to uploaded artifacts. For SOC2 attestation checks, loop in Marissa (cc'd) — she coordinates audit evidence ingestion and will be our primary contact.

Next steps: 1) Can you add a caiaq_field column to your CSV and re-send, 2) confirm a two-day window the week of Sep 13 for presign + upload, 3) let us know any constraints around timestamped signatures vs. raw hashes.

Cheers,
David Kim
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-presign-playbook.pdf (PDF stub, 7 pages)

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@clearforge.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: operations@clearforge.com
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 12:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Archer portal onboarding - presign + evidence mapping

David — appreciated. Quick answers: 

- We'll add caiaq_field to the CSV and include SHA256 for all artifacts. Hashes will be calculated at source; we can include a signed timestamp column if you want a timeproof (we usually include unix_ts and sig_alg columns).
- KMS key: our key alias is alias/clearforge-ingest-us-west-2. Rotations are automated monthly; for onboarding we can pause rotation for one cycle and target Sep 14-15 for upload.
- Presign TTL: 72 hours works. We'll coordinate the final presigns for Sep 14 08:00-18:00 PST.

Also: Do you require a DocuSign addendum for limited presign access? We can push an MSA addendum if needed.

On the SOC2 attestation front, point our auditors to Marissa and Kimberly and we'll coordinate any signed certs.

Thanks — attaching the updated index template as evidence-hash-template.csv to show the new columns.

—Alyssa

Attachment: evidence-hash-template.csv (csv stub, sample rows)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@clearforge.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Archer portal onboarding - presign + evidence mapping

Hi all — quick ops note from the intake side: 

1) We can accept unix_ts + sha256 as you suggested. If you include a sig_alg column with the hash algorithm (sha256) that's helpful for automation.
2) For the KMS rotation ask: we request a KMS key policy statement showing which principal will perform rotations (just a one-paragraph clause). If you can paste that in the CSV (or send a short confirmation email) it's enough for our records.
3) Workshop: Jonas and I can run a 30–45 minute onboarding workshop to walk through the Archer mapping, ingestion runbook, and a quick dry-run. Proposed slots: Sep 13 09:30–10:15 PST or Sep 14 11:00–11:45 PST. Which works for your team?

Deliverables we'll produce on our side after the workshop: a final mapping table (CSV), an ingestion dry-run summary, and a short evidence provenance note we attach to the Archer profile.

If everyone is aligned, we'll provision a temporary upload token for your ops team and send a DocuSign envelope for the limited-access addendum (only required for customers with custom presign policies).

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Principal Security Operations Coordinator
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none) — will share mapping after workshop.

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@clearforge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2027 17:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Archer portal onboarding - presign + evidence mapping

All — confirming the plan: 

- Clearforge will perform uploads on Sep 14 between 08:00–18:00 PST with 72-hour presign TTLs.
- Clearforge will pause their automated monthly KMS rotation for the onboarding cycle and target actual rotation for Sep 19 06:00 PST (>=96h after final presign). Please provide the KMS rotation principal statement by EOD Sep 10 for audit purposes.
- Marissa/Jonas: run the 30-minute workshop on Sep 13 at 09:30 PST (zoom link below).
- Alyssa: we'll prepare the DocuSign addendum and send the envelope by EOD Sep 9. Please sign to enable temporary token provisioning.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=workshop
DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.net/envelope/ABC123efg456

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the dry-run.

-David
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
